_doc: Which full-alignment layers may be published (pipeline/scripts/publish_safe.py; every full-align repo: full-alignments-manual, -manual-sa, -llm). Owner rule 2026-10-21: a full-aligned edition is published when its TEXT has an open licence: public domain, CC0 or any Creative Commons licence, NC and ND included. The text licence is taken from `text_licences` (by edition id, as in the layer's manifest entry), else from the edition's pin `license` field (config/pins/<tag>.json), else from eBible's licence line in config/edition_struct/<tag>.json when it says public domain. A copyright line alone (`© ...`) names no licence and does not count. No open licence found = the layer is NOT published (it stays local; publish_safe prints why). `hold` keeps a layer local whatever its licence. Layers already on Hugging Face are never deleted by this; they are just not updated. Keep source/reason and date for every entry.
